limitations: This deterministic inventory does not reassess evidence, verdicts, completion or scientific quality.
Legacy rows preserve unknown scientific/completion/target-hash values; report hashes hash reports.
Working-tree target hashes are declarations, not proof that those bytes exist at the recorded commit.
Coverage inputs come from the entire tracked baseline tree, independently of ignore rules.

policy.name: any_prior_target_review_coverage
policy.predicate: eligible iff no prior canonical, structured-inventory or legacy record
policy.structured_only_counts: Informative alternative only; not the eligibility predicate.
policy.unit: target_id and unambiguous target_path, independent of review_id and target hash
